learning_objective.text_en: Construct, read, interpret, and draw inferences from tables and statistical data from bar charts, pie charts, pictograms, stem-and-leaf diagrams and frequency tables. This can consist of averages of given data.
learning_objective.text_zh: 构建、读取、解释和从表格和统计数据中得出推论，如条形图、饼图、象形图、茎叶图和频率表。这可以包括给定数据的平均值。
